sources.snippet: Qwen3-VL-Embedding is a unified multimodal vector model based on Qwen3-VL, supporting text, image, video (single or mixed modality) input. It outputs unified representation vectors, suitable for cross-modal retrieval, image/video search, clustering, complex multimodal retrieval, and tagging.
